I'm Adam Villalobos. I help people eliminate chronic nerve pain, numbness, and thoracic outlet syndrome.

I'm a licensed massage therapist, certified personal trainer, and U.S. Army veteran who learned the hard way that the traditional healthcare system doesn't fix chronic pain. It just masks it.

So I spent years studying trigger point therapy, sports massage, and corrective training. Then I combined it all into one system that actually works.

On this channel, I'll show you exactly how to find the trigger points causing your pain, fix your posture, and get back to the activities you love. No fluff. Just step-by-step techniques that work.

Based in San Diego | Helping people worldwide through online programs
